label: Agnus Dei, K.626 — complete traditional Süssmayr full-orchestral rendition
description: Complete source-MIDI-derived Agnus Dei Full Rendition extracted from measures 1–51 of the CC0 K.626 tail witness. The same source continues directly into the 82-measure Communio after the 3/4 → 4/4 boundary.

provenance.provider: dominicfanucchi/aai-511_group1 — CC0 classical MIDI dataset mirror
provenance.attribution: Source dataset mirror maintained by Dominic Fanucchi et al.; repository README explicitly releases the dataset under CC0 1.0.
provenance.transformation: Parsed approved local Standard MIDI File; preserved note onset/duration, velocity, source track/channel identity, tempo events and time signatures. Extracted source measures 1-51 and shifted the retained movement to quarter-unit 0.
